content: {"episode_id":"ep-05049","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring) for diagnosis codes I49.5 and I49.9. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of underlying sick sinus syndrome and unspecified cardiac arrhythmia. Given the paroxysmal nature of these symptoms and the need for continuous rhythm correlation over an extended period, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was ordered to capture and characterize the arrhythmic events. The payer letter invites supporting clinical documentation justifying medical necessity, and this indication supports coverage of the $628.86 balance."}
